title: Dinosaur Blood Cells Detected in 115-Million-Year-Old Fossil
caption:
Could a 115-million-year-old dinosaur fossil hold the secret to ancient biology? Scientists have identified potential blood cells tucked inside an Aratasaurus bone, confirmed by chemical signatures like heme. It's not a Jurassic Park scenario, but it proves museum collections may be hiding microscopic treasures.

Source: Sciencealert - Dinosaur Blood Cells Detected in 115-Million-Year-Old Fossil
